body.en:
Question B-002-005-002.

Why the correct answer is right: A routine Morse answer identifies the station being answered, sends DE, and then gives your own call sign, each with enough repetition to copy.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Send your call sign four times": Sending only your own call four times does not clearly name the CQ station you are answering.
- sourceIndex 2: "Send the other station's call sign once, followed by the word \"DE,\" followed by your call sign four times": One called-station call and four of yours is not the balanced answer pattern taught here.
- sourceIndex 3: "Send your call sign followed by your name, station location and a signal report": Name, location, and report belong later in the contact, after the stations have established contact.
